## Method overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | Empirical indicators → Multi-indicator frameworks |
| **Method name** | Multi-indicator dashboards (traffic light) |
| **Short description** | Traffic-light tables that combine several indicators of abundance, size structure, exploitation and ecosystem state, including local knowledge, with agreed responses for each colour. |
| **Main outputs** | Traffic-light table combining indicators of abundance, size, exploitation and ecosystem state; decision rules for management responses |
| **Typical use case** | Several quantitative and qualitative indicators, including local knowledge |
